title: Operator Paceboard and Forecast View for Dedicated Fleets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a new Console workspace (Operator Paceboard) that combines real-time scaling controls, a 24h/7d throughput forecast panel, and an immutable change replay for Dedicated fleets. The goal is to give operators a single place to: 1) nudge and pin per-fleet throughput targets, 2) preview autoscaler reactions to manual adjustments and scheduled policies, and 3) inspect and replay configuration changes with exact timestamps and operator comments for audit and incident postmortems.
background: Current fleet controls are dispersed across the Capacity page, Rollouts, and Logs. Operators frequently request a single-pane view that couples manual adjustments with immediate forecasted cost/latency impact and a tamper-evident history. This ticket consolidates those needs and implements a forecast model that simulates autoscaler behavior given the current policy and a hypothetical traffic curve.
requirements: Paceboard UI that exposes a per-fleet throughput slider with fine and coarse modes (+/- tokens/s and % change)
Forecast panel: deterministic 24h simulation using recent traffic distribution and active autoscale policies; shows percentiles (p50/p95) for latency and cost delta estimates
Policy simulator: given a manual slider change, show predicted autoscaler actions (scale up/down, cooldowns, burst allowances) and resultant capacity timeline
Change replay: immutable audit trail entries with operator, timestamp, diff view, and optional freeform comment; ability to replay changes into the simulator
APIs: backend endpoints to read/write paceboard state, compute forecasts asynchronously, and produce signed audit entries
RBAC: only fleet-operators and admins can apply persistent paceboard overrides; view-only roles can run simulations
Telemetry: instrument events for slider interactions, simulation runs, and applied overrides for SLO and billing analysis
acceptance_criteria: A functional Console page at /console/fleets/{fleet_id}/paceboard that loads in <1.2s for fleets with <= 50 routes
Slider applies a non-persistent simulation by default and can be committed as an override with a single confirm click
Forecast returns within 3s for a baseline 24h simulation and matches offline run results within 5% for cost estimates
Change replay renders a chronological diff and allows an operator to annotate an existing audit entry
Backend persists signed audit entries to the existing audit-log store and surfaces them via the /api/fleets/{fleet_id}/audit endpoint
E2E test coverage for RBAC behavior and simulation vs. offline forecast parity
implementation_notes: Frontend: React + existing Console component library; reuse timeline component from rollout-history
Backend: add /simulate-forecast endpoint that uses the existing autoscaler model in eng/sim and caches results for 60s
Telemetry: emit simulation_id and sample_seed for reproducibility
Performance: forecast compute runs in worker pool; fallback to precomputed conservative estimate if worker queue exceeds threshold
Data: use last 72h of route-level arrival distribution and current model of KV-cache hit rates for cost delta estimates
